newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - State poll threatens Australia federal meet.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - State poll threatens Australia federal meet.

text.p: Australian federal and state officials expect the Council of Australian Governments meeting scheduled for Friday may well be cancelled because of the calling of an election in Western Australia.

The meeting, at which the federal and state governments iron out deals to foster economic reform, is supposed to be held in Brisbane. But the officials see a high risk that Western Australian Premier Richard Court will call an election between now and then. "There's a very good chance," said one official.
If Court were to call an election, his government would revert to the status of a caretaker administration charged with conducting only essential and non-controversial business.
